voiceNote: gibberish (a proposal until Jonny has heard it)
notes: No hat, no weapon, no prop. One garment: the sunny yellow hoodie (costumes-everyday.js), hood down as a thick rolled cowl closing in a V, two white drawstrings, a pouch pocket, ribbed hem and cuffs. Two leaves in a V. Brown trousers, white trainers with one red stripe. A round ball, 0.65 of Spud's height as on his sheet. Same skin, eyes and hands as Spud.
